topic: A student is accused of plagiarism
text: I don't understand how this happened. I worked so hard on that paper, spent countless nights in the library, pouring over articles and books to get every detail right. I made sure to cite every source, every time. Now I'm being called to the dean's office, and they're talking about plagiarism. I've never done anything like this before; I know the rules, I respect them. It must be a mistake. Maybe there's a way to explain, to show them that it’s all just a misunderstanding. I need to find the right words, the right proof. I can fix this, right? I have to.
